statement: Annotated blind from the Beinecke scan only (canvas 1006192, '66r'). The page is almost all text: a long paragraph, with two narrow columns in the left margin (a column of single words and a column of single glyphs, which the line ids f66r.1-.49 mark as labels; they point at no drawn object). The only drawings are in the bottom-left margin: a small nude figure lying on its back with legs stretched to the lower left, two small circles with dotted interiors, and a small open tub, with a few Latin-script letters in a different hand beside the circles. One line of Voynich text runs directly above the figure; as the only label line after the paragraph (f66r.82), it is assigned to the figure by position. The faint blue-green shapes in the middle of the page are show-through or offset from another leaf, and the green at the left edge belongs to the facing page; neither is annotated.
